fixes: Resume chunk runner now repairs valid JSONL files missing a trailing newline and quarantines invalid partial tails before counting rows.
Resume chunk runner now validates all existing JSONL rows before appending and rejects GENERATION_SKIP_FAILED=true because count-based resume requires gap-free output.
Concurrent direct-vLLM conversation generation now flushes completed responses in input order, so line-count resume remains a valid leading-prefix offset.
Resume submitter now fails if sbatch output cannot be parsed into a job id, preventing unsafe multi-wave dependency chains.
SpecDec-RL grpo.py generation timing block is no longer nested under the optional clear_vllm_logger_metrics hook, so non-vLLM generation backends cannot skip rollout by accident.
SpecDec vLLM log stats now default to disabled for fair baseline comparisons unless NRL_VLLM_DISABLE_LOG_STATS explicitly opts in.
Any no-dependency resume submission now requires explicit --allow-no-previous-dependency after checking no concurrent writer is active.
Direct vLLM submit wrapper now builds sbatch arguments as an array, so no-dependency dry-runs and submissions do not fail on an empty SBATCH_EXTRA_ARGV.
Finalizer submitter now prints that dependency discovery is a submission-time squeue snapshot.
SpecDec-RL overlay validator now checks the current NRL_SPECDEC_BATCH_GATE_PATCH_V7 marker plus scheduler-output all-disabled runtime fixture and the grpo generation-block indentation invariant.
Added a missing-ID repair path for chunks that have interior gaps from earlier unordered concurrent writes, avoiding unsafe count-based resume.
Direct vLLM submit wrapper now requests sbatch --mem=0 by default and forwards CPUS_PER_WORKER=64 to Ray, fixing the missing-ID repair Ray startup memory failure.
Resume submitter now supports explicit --chunk-list ranges for exact inactive chunk targeting.
Count-based resume now validates that existing ids are a contiguous leading prompt prefix before launching vLLM; unsafe interior-hole chunks are rejected with instructions to use missing-id repair.
Missing-ID repair now refuses OpenMath smoke PROMPT_DATA unless explicitly allowed and also refuses prompt files shorter than the highest requested chunk id.
Qwen3-235B finalizer now accepts replacement conversations, preventing duplicate prompts in the raw 500K pool from reducing the exact-unique final corpus below 500K.

Safe-w4 repair chain 3065583-3065686 replaced stale jobs 3063256-3063318 after review found unsafe partial-apply/wave4 dependencies; it was later superseded by direct adaptive missing-ID repair job 3068010 and finalizer/train chain 3068014-3068017.
Qwen3-30B/235B SpecDec launchers now wait for an in-progress Megatron checkpoint conversion to write iter_0000000/run_config.yaml before submitting another job against the same checkpoint directory.
SpecDec dynamic-K per-position acceptance now validates scheduler tier counters against vLLM num_drafts and num_draft_tokens before allowing those rates to drive the step controller.
SpecDec aggregate acceptance is now marked reliable only when all DP workers report, and the dynamic-K step controller refuses partial-DP metrics.
